prompts.title: Luxury 3D watch product experience page (Next.js + Three.js)
prompts.source: Shin@プログラミングチュートリアル
prompts.prompt:
Design a 3D product experience page for a luxury wristwatch.
**Target users:** wealthy customers, watch enthusiasts, and business people aged 30–50.
**Brand tone:** Luxury × Tech (a modern, sophisticated high-end feel).
Scroll experience (5 sections):
Hero section – the wristwatch slowly appears from darkness into light while rotating. Implement holographic effects and Fresnel reflections with custom shaders.
Detail zoom – close-up of the dial. Use GLSL to achieve metallic reflections, parallax mapping, and real-time glossiness.
Mechanism breakdown – the watch disassembles and the internal movement floats in space. Use a displacement shader for an energy-field effect and add glow effects to each part.
Material experience – switch between different material variations. Express metalness, glass refraction, and the matte texture of titanium with PBR shaders in a physically based way.
Ending – the watch reassembles, with an abstract gradient mesh background made with a custom shader. Apply post-processing such as bloom and depth of field.
**Tech stack:** Next.js 15 + Three.js + React Three Fiber + GLSL (custom shaders) + react-postprocessing + Lenis.
Shader requirements:
Fresnel reflection shader (rim-light effect)
PBR material shader (roughness, metallic, AO)
Holographic shader (iridescent interference effect)
Displacement shader (waving and distortion effects)
Custom background shader (gradient noise)
Post-process: Bloom, ChromaticAberration, DepthOfField, Vignette.
Please propose specific numerical values for:
Scroll range of each section (in % or vh units)
Animation parameters (start/end values for position, rotation, scale, etc.)
Easing functions (ease type)
Camera FOV, position, and target values
Lighting settings (intensity, color, position)
Uniform values for each shader (time progression, scroll progress, hue, intensity, etc.).

参照画像の人物の無修正ドキュメンタリー風写真。85mm単焦点レンズ搭載のフルサイズデジタルカメラで撮影。年齢、性別、祖先、顔、髪、肌の色と質感、体型、身長の印象、プロポーションなど、あらゆる身体的特徴を参照画像からのみ忠実に推測・保持し、決して美化、年齢操作、整形、特徴の捏造を行わないこと。これは胴体全体に適用される。胸部やバストのサイズ、形状、位置、肩幅、肋骨、ウエスト、ヒップ、四肢の太さはすべて、参照画像に表示されている通りとする。胸部を拡大、縮小、リフトアップ、丸くするなどの変更を加えず、体のどの部分も細くしたり、長くしたり、理想化したりしない。参照画像が明白に成人を描いている場合にのみ、柔らかいネックラインとフィットしたショーツを使用し、そうでない場合は、ネックラインが鎖骨の位置にあるキャミソールと、同じ色と雰囲気のストレートカットの太もも丈のショーツを使用する。いずれの場合も、ショーツは完全に不透明で、下着が見えないようにする。シーン：7月下旬の古い日本家屋の木製縁側を庭から見た様子。風化した暗い色の木柱と紙の障子が背景を埋め、開いた戸口の向こうに薄暗い部屋が見える。軒先から被写体の横、頭の高さあたりに、短冊の付いた小さなガラスの風鈴が吊るされている。右下の床には、カットされたスイカが乗った白いエナメル盆の縁が入っている。左端には夏の緑が迫っている。床板は不均一に摩耗し、本物の木目や擦り傷がある。ポーズ：被写体は一段高い縁側の端に座り、カメラに対してきれいな横向きで、体の正面は庭の方を向いている。片方の膝を立てて素足を床に乗せ、もう片方の足は縁側から下に伸ばしている。被写体は片手にスイカの一片を持ち、顔の横から口元に運び、その肘は立てた膝の近くに置かれている。もう片方の腕は後ろに伸ばし、手のひらを腰の後ろの床に平らに押し付けているため、胴体は直立して開いた状態になり、胸の前を遮るものはない。視線はカメラから離れ、庭の向こうを向いている。表情は気だるげでポーズを取っておらず、撮影のために静止しているのではなく、一口食べている途中の瞬間を捉えたものである。服装：サンドアイボリーのコットンジャージー素材の、何度も洗濯された使い古された日常的なキャミソール。ニットは柔らかく少しへたっており、縁取りされたネックラインは元の張りを失い、作られた時よりも少し低く緩んでいる。細いストラップは着用により伸びており、ピンと張るのではなく緩んでいるが、両方とも肩に正しく留まっている。色は不均一に色あせ、裾はわずかにカールし、生地には夏の間ずっと家で着ていた衣服特有の定着したシワがある。完全に不透明で、構造やパッドはなく、成形やサポートも組み込まれていないため、単に参照の身体に従っている。スレートグレーのコットンリネンショーツも同様に使い古されて柔らかく、体にフィットしたカットで裾は太ももの高い位置にあり、リラックスしたドローストリングは結ばれずに残され、座ったことによる軽いシワがある。ヒーロービジュアル：木柱、障子のレール、風鈴の吊り紐など、フレーム内のすべての垂直線は完全に静止しており、風鈴の下の短冊だけが写真の中で揺れている唯一の要素で、垂直からわずかに外れてぶら下がっている。カメラとフレーミング：庭から座った時の肩の高さあたりで撮影されたミディアムショット。傾きのない水平な位置で、被写体の横顔に対して正対している。フレームは頭のすぐ上から太ももの中間までで、顔全体、両肩、胴体全体、ウエスト、座った腰、太ももの上半分がすべてはっきりと読み取れ、フレームを満たしている。膝下でクロップし、下脚と足は写さない。カメラを被写体の後ろに配置しないこと。胴体の前面と横顔の両方が読み取れなければならない。股の間をフレームに収めないこと。ライティング：自然光のみ。曇天の明るい真夏の正午。開けた庭からの柔らかく均一な日光、被写体の後ろで深い自然な陰影になる縁側の内部、芝生からの肌への涼しげな緑の反射光、木材からのわずかな暖かい反射光。スタジオライト、リムライト、人工的なフィルライトは使用しない。写真のリアリズム：全体を通して本物の光学挙動。f/2.8前後の適度な被写界深度で、背景の障子と緑は緩やかに柔らかく、顔に焦点を合わせる。軽微なレンズ周辺減光、最も明るいハイライト部分のかすかな色収差、影になった室内の自然なセンサーノイズ、ガラスの風鈴とエナメル盆のわずかにクリップされた鏡面ハイライト。肌のスムージング、エアブラシ、いかなる種類のレタッチも行わない。生地は本物の重力の下で本物のシワを持ってドレープする。コットンジャージーは、柔らかい折り目があり、パリッとした感じがなく、硬い構造を持たない、本物の着古されたニットのように振る舞う。フォーマット：3:4 prompts.title: Cinematic Contact Sheet Generation from Reference Image Prompt
prompts.prompt: Study the uploaded image carefully and fully internalize the scene: the subject’s appearance, clothing, posture, emotional state, and the surrounding environment. Treat this moment as a single frozen point in time. Create a cinematic image set that feels like a photographer methodically explored this exact moment from multiple distances and angles, without changing anything about the subject or location. All images must clearly belong to the same scene, captured under the same lighting conditions, weather, and atmosphere. Nothing in the world changes — only the camera position and framing evolve. The emotional tone should remain consistent throughout the set, subtly expressed through posture, gaze, and micro-expressions rather than exaggerated acting. Begin by observing the subject within the environment from afar, letting the surroundings dominate the frame and establish scale and mood. Gradually move closer, allowing the subject’s full presence to emerge, then narrowing attention toward body language and facial expression. End with intimate perspectives that reveal small but meaningful details — texture, touch, or eye focus — before shifting perspective above and below the subject to suggest reflection, vulnerability, or quiet resolve. Across the sequence: Wider views should emphasize space and atmosphere Mid-range views should emphasize posture and emotional context Close views should isolate feeling and detail Perspective shifts (low and high angles) should feel purposeful and cinematic, not decorative Depth of field must behave naturally: distant views remain mostly sharp, while closer frames introduce shallow focus and gentle background separation. The final result should read as a cohesive 3×3 cinematic contact sheet, as if selected from a single roll of film documenting one emotional moment from multiple viewpoints. No text, symbols, signage, watermarks, numbers, or graphic elements may appear anywhere in the images. Photorealistic rendering, cinematic color grading, and consistent visual realism are mandatory.

prompts.title: Luxury 3D watch product experience page (Next.js + Three.js)
prompts.source: Shin@プログラミングチュートリアル
prompts.prompt:
Design a 3D product experience page for a luxury wristwatch.
**Target users:** wealthy customers, watch enthusiasts, and business people aged 30–50.
**Brand tone:** Luxury × Tech (a modern, sophisticated high-end feel).
Scroll experience (5 sections):
Hero section – the wristwatch slowly appears from darkness into light while rotating. Implement holographic effects and Fresnel reflections with custom shaders.
Detail zoom – close-up of the dial. Use GLSL to achieve metallic reflections, parallax mapping, and real-time glossiness.
Mechanism breakdown – the watch disassembles and the internal movement floats in space. Use a displacement shader for an energy-field effect and add glow effects to each part.
Material experience – switch between different material variations. Express metalness, glass refraction, and the matte texture of titanium with PBR shaders in a physically based way.
Ending – the watch reassembles, with an abstract gradient mesh background made with a custom shader. Apply post-processing such as bloom and depth of field.
**Tech stack:** Next.js 15 + Three.js + React Three Fiber + GLSL (custom shaders) + react-postprocessing + Lenis.
Shader requirements:
Fresnel reflection shader (rim-light effect)
PBR material shader (roughness, metallic, AO)
Holographic shader (iridescent interference effect)
Displacement shader (waving and distortion effects)
Custom background shader (gradient noise)
Post-process: Bloom, ChromaticAberration, DepthOfField, Vignette.
Please propose specific numerical values for:
Scroll range of each section (in % or vh units)
Animation parameters (start/end values for position, rotation, scale, etc.)
Easing functions (ease type)
Camera FOV, position, and target values
Lighting settings (intensity, color, position)
Uniform values for each shader (time progression, scroll progress, hue, intensity, etc.).

It is happily rolling out dough on a wooden table, surrounded by gingerbread men cookies that have come to life and are running around the kitchen counter laughing. Warm, storybook art style.

A friendly purple octopus is using all eight arms to decorate a large piece of branching coral that looks like a Christmas tree. It's hanging shiny seashells, starfish, and strings of pearls on the branches. A Santa hat floats just above its head. Bubbles rise against a deep blue ocean background. Cute cartoon style.

prompts.title: Magical Snowy Owl Delivering Mail

It carries a small, elegant red envelope sealed with a gold wax seal in its beak. A tiny sprig of holly is tucked behind its ear like a feather. The style is detailed and enchanting.

prompts.title: Sneaky Raccoons Stealing Santa's Treats

Two sneaky raccoons wearing their natural "bandit mask" markings and tiny Santa hats are caught in the act. One is lifting a glass of milk, and the other has a chocolate chip cookie in its mouth, taken from a plate labeled 'For Santa'. Only their eyes are illuminated by the firelight. Cute, mischievous illustration style.

prompts.title: Penguin Skiing with Candy Canes
prompts.prompt: A whimsical action illustration for a Christmas card, aspect ratio 1:1.4. A cheerful penguin wearing vintage pilot goggles and a flying red scarf is skiing down a snowy slope. Instead of skis, it is using two large peppermint candy canes. Snow sprays out behind it dynamically. In the background, there are simple cartoon pine trees. Fun, dynamic cartoon style with bold outlines.

prompts.title: Sleeping Polar Bears
prompts.prompt: A heartwarming printable Christmas card, aspect ratio 1:1.4. A large mother polar bear is lying down fast asleep, curled up in a snowy drift. A tiny polar bear cub is sleeping soundly on her broad back, wearing a miniature red and green striped nightcap. A gentle snowfall surrounds them against a soft light blue background. The style is a tender children's book illustration with soft colors.

prompts.title: Tuxedo Cat Tangled in Ribbon
prompts.prompt: A funny printable Christmas card illustration, aspect ratio 1:1.4. A mischievous black and white tuxedo cat is comically tangled in a massive explosion of red satin gift ribbon and torn festive wrapping paper on a clean white background. Only its wide, surprised green eyes and one paw are visible from the center of the shiny red chaos. A roll of tape is stuck to its tail. Dynamic cartoon sketch style.

prompts.title: Capybara in Japanese Hot Spring
prompts.prompt: A relaxing and cute Christmas illustration, aspect ratio 1:1.4. A chill capybara sits peacefully up to its chest in a steaming Japanese hot spring pool (onsen), surrounded by snow-covered rocks. It wears a small folded towel on its head topped with a Santa hat. A yuzu fruit floats next to it. The style is a warm, soft anime illustration with gentle steam rising.

prompts.title: Singing Birds on Holly Branch
prompts.prompt: A cute and detailed printable Christmas card, aspect ratio 1:1.4. Five tiny, plump garden birds (a robin, a blue tit, a sparrow, a goldfinch, a wren) are perched in a row on a snow-covered holly branch with red berries. Each bird wears a different miniature knitted winter hat (bobble hat, beanie, earflap hat) and they all have their beaks open as if singing. The style is a delicate watercolor and ink drawing on textured paper.

prompts.title: Squirrel with Wrapped Acorn

It is holding a single acorn that is meticulously wrapped in tiny red paper with a gold bow, presenting it forward. Behind it, a pile of similarly wrapped acorns is stacked inside a hollow log. The squirrel wears a tiny green knit scarf. Colored pencil texture style.

Smoke puffs out around it in the shape of question marks.

Its shaggy hair completely covers its eyes, but colorful tangled Christmas lights that are glowing, and small shiny red baubles, are caught in its bangs and long horns. Light snowflakes dust its fur. The background is a soft, blurred snowy pasture. Painterly, textured style.

prompts.title: Snowman and Birds on Park Bench
prompts.prompt:
A beautiful and charming winter illustration, perfect for a printable greeting card. A friendly snowman with a carrot nose, coal eyes, and a smile sits on a weathered green wooden park bench partially covered in soft snow. The snowman is dressed in a dark brown fedora and a warm red and yellow patterned scarf, with twig arms resting on the bench.

A vibrant red cardinal is perched on the back of the bench. Next to the snowman sits a small burlap sack overflowing with birdseed. Several cute black-capped chickadees are happily eating seeds on the bench and on the snowy ground in the foreground.

The background shows a serene, snowy landscape with a forest of pine trees under a pale, overcast sky with large, soft snowflakes gently falling. The entire scene has a soft, painterly texture with a gentle, embossed quality, creating a heartwarming and peaceful mood.

High detail, intricate, beautiful illustration, printable quality. --ar 1:1.4

prompts.prompt:

The design is set against a solid, very pale pink background.

prompts.title: Vintage Disney Characters Christmas
prompts.prompt:
An exquisite, printable Christmas greeting card featuring classic Disney characters in a vintage 2D illustration style, aspect ratio 1:1.4. The overall mood is cheerful and festive.

The scene is set against a vibrant bright green background, lightly speckled with shimmering gold glitter. In the center stands a lush Christmas tree decorated with colorful ornaments and topped with a large, shining gold glitter star.

A group of beloved Disney characters, all dressed in Santa Claus outfits with red suits and hats trimmed in white fur, are gathered around the tree. At the top left, Goofy peeks out from behind the tree, waving happily. On the upper right, Donald Duck excitedly holds a wrapped gift.

In the foreground at the bottom, Minnie Mouse stands on the left, wearing a Santa dress with a holly accent, striking a sweet, shy pose. prompts.title: Anime Dance Video in Pop-up Book Style
prompts.source: クリラボ｜Curious Creator Lab｜AIクリエイター
prompts.prompt: # 6-Second Pop-Up Step Dance Video Prompt Use the character in the reference image as the sole protagonist. **6 seconds, 24 fps, vertical 9:16.** High-quality Japanese full-color animation. Art as refined as a theatrical anime movie, smooth body movements, rich facial expression changes, and naturally swaying hair and costumes. In a world of a colorful pop-up picture book, the protagonist performs a light step dance, creating an ultra-short dance video that is easy to play repeatedly on social media. ## Core Objectives * Hook viewers with both movement and expression in the first 0.3 seconds * Create a dance that utilizes footwork and a sense of rhythm different from previous works * Include a signature move that can be remembered after just one viewing * Use 5 cameras with detailed cut-ins to create pace and flow in the video * Create a loop structure that returns from the end to the beginning without feeling unnatural * Prioritize the protagonist's cuteness, friendliness, and energy * Structure the video to lead to saves, repeat plays, and imitation of the choreography ## Character Consistency The protagonist is the character from the reference image themselves. Maintain the following features seen in the reference image across all cameras, poses, expressions, and frames: * Hairstyle * Hair color * Shape of bangs * Eye color * Facial features * Skin color * Physique * Head-to-body ratio * Perceived age * Costume * Costume color scheme * Shoes * Accessories * Overall atmosphere Do not change faces or physiques even when cameras switch. Do not allow character changes, costume changes, hairstyle changes, or disappearance of accessories. Keep fingers in natural shapes and correctly depict left and right limbs. ## Setting The setting is a miniature dance stage created inside a giant pop-up picture book. Place the following decorations on a 3D floor that looks like an open page: * Clouds made of paper * Small star-shaped lights * Colorful building blocks * An arched background * Round stage lights * Small shapes like confetti The background colors should center on cream, coral pink, sky blue, lemon yellow, and lavender. Give the background a sense of three-dimensionality, but do not let it stand out more than the protagonist. Do not feature any persons other than the protagonist, dancers, audience members, or animals. ## Music **Completely original Japanese vocal track.** Do not make it resemble existing songs, anime songs, popular hits, or nursery rhymes. Bright and cute, up-tempo J-POP/anime-pop style. Do not include a short intro; start the vocals, beat, and melody simultaneously from 0 seconds. Use the following sounds in the music: * Light drums * Bright synthesizers * Small hand claps * Bell-like high notes * Bouncy bass * Cute accent sounds that feel like 'pon,' 'pah,' and 'kira.' Synchronize the choreography, camera switches, and background movement with the beat. The song should be approximately 5 seconds long, naturally ending the vocals and melody around 5.0 to 5.3 seconds. For the final 0.7 seconds, leave only a short lingering sound and sound effects that lead into the loop. Do not display text, subtitles, or lyrics. ## Video Concept The protagonist moves left and right on a small stage, performing a bright and cute dance combining bouncy steps and handclaps. Clearly show the following full-body movements, not just the upper body: * Steps opening toes left and right * Small lateral movements * Movements tucking knees inward * Rhythmical up-and-down movement of shoulders * Light turns * Handclaps synchronized with timing * Final one-legged balance pose Do not use intense acrobatics or large jumps. Make the choreography easy for anyone to imitate and want to dance along with the sound source. ## Signature Move Use the 'Pata-Pata Step' as the unique signature move for this video. 1. Open both hands outward at shoulder height. 2. Quickly flick wrists in and out twice. 3. Simultaneously open toes in the order of right, then left. 4. Cross both hands once in front of the chest. 5. Vigorously open the crossed hands diagonally upward. 6. Lift one leg slightly, tilt the head, and freeze with a smile. Perform hand and foot movements to the same rhythm, creating choreography that can be remembered just by its silhouette. Do not center the choreography around hearts, pointing, cheek-side peace signs, or blown kisses. ## Pop-Up Effects Unlike the previous work's crayon-style effects, use a 3D papercraft expression that looks like paper cutouts layered together. Motifs to use: * Small triangles * Colorful circles * Paper tape * Zigzag lines * Miniature clouds * Star-shaped paper pieces * Semicircular arches * Spring-like lines * Small confetti * Wavy ribbon-like paper Effects should appear as if popping out from the stage floor or background. Use the following movements: * Rising from the page * Folded paper opening * Bouncing once like a spring * Swaying slightly left and right * Scattering as confetti * Retracting back into the page Do not overlap too much on the protagonist's face or body. Use them to reinforce the direction of movement, foot landings, and the moment of handclaps. ## 5-Camera Configuration Use 5 cameras, but do not simply cycle through them every second. Insert short 0.2 to 0.5-second cut-ins in the middle of a longer main shot, changing perspectives according to the beat. ### Camera A: Front Wide Camera Main camera showing the protagonist's full body and the entire stage. An angle where choreography, footwork, and lateral movement are clear. Slightly dolly back and forth to follow the protagonist's movement naturally. ### Camera B: Low-Angle Camera from Diagonally Below Capture the protagonist from a low position in front of the stage, looking diagonally up. Emphasize foot landings, opening/closing of toes, and the swaying of the costume. Do not use an extreme low angle; maintain cuteness. ### Camera C: Right-Front Tracking Camera Run parallel to the protagonist's lateral movement from the front right. Show the coordination of face, shoulders, waist, and arms. The protagonist returns their gaze to the lens once during movement. ### Camera D: Top Camera from Directly Above Show floor shapes, foot trajectories, and paper effects in a circular composition. Use briefly as a beat accent rather than for long periods. ### Camera E: Face and Upper-Body Close-Up Camera Show changes in expression, handclaps, and head-tilting movements. Not a static close-up of the face; slide slightly sideways following the protagonist's movement. ## Camera Direction Do not use flashy glitches or flashes for camera switches. Use the following natural transitions: * Cut at the moment the protagonist's arm crosses the screen * Cut at the moment paper tape passes in front of the screen * Change the angle at the moment a foot lands on the floor * Connect directions according to the protagonist's turns * Use match cuts utilizing the background arches Even when cuts change, accurately connect the protagonist's arms, legs, body direction, and movement position. Ensure the same action doesn't rewind midway or suddenly become a different pose. ## 6-Second Timeline ### 0.0–0.7 seconds **Camera E: Close-up of face and upper body.** The protagonist is already in rhythm at the start. Bounce both shoulders alternately while quickly opening both hands beside the face. Change from slightly widened eyes (as if surprised) to a joyful smile. Around 0.2 seconds, background paper arches rise all at once. Small star-shaped paper pieces pop out from both sides of the face. The camera pulls back briefly once to transition to the next full-body shot. ### 0.7–1.6 seconds **Camera A: Front wide.** The protagonist moves two small steps to the right. Open both hands outward on the first step and clap in front of the chest on the second step. At the moment of the clap, a circular paper effect pops open from under the feet. Use knees and toes softly so the entire body appears to bounce. ### 1.6–2.0 seconds **Camera B: Short low-angle cut-in.** Capture the moment the protagonist lands their right foot on the floor and points their left toe outward. Triangles and zigzag lines pop out from the floor upon landing. Hair and costume hems sway with a slight delay. The protagonist's hand crosses in front of the screen at the end of the cut-in. ### 2.0–3.0 seconds **Camera C: Tracking from front right.** The protagonist performs the first half of the 'Pata-Pata Step' while returning to the left. Open both hands at shoulder height and flick wrists in and out twice. Simultaneously open toes in the order of right, then left. Look in the direction of travel at first, then send a gaze to the camera on the final wrist flick. Background paper tape waves according to the protagonist's movement. ### 3.0–3.4 seconds **Camera D: Short top-down cut-in.** The protagonist crosses both hands in front of the chest and brings both feet together in the center. Circles and stars drawn on the floor rotate once around the protagonist. Confetti spreads outward but disappears quickly to clean up the screen. ### 3.4–4.5 seconds **Camera A: Front wide.** The protagonist widely opens both crossed hands diagonally upward, completing the 'Pata-Pata Step.' Continuously bounce shoulders twice and take small steps in the order of right foot, then left foot. Background clouds and star-shaped lights move up and down alternately in sync with movements. The camera slowly approaches the protagonist. ### 4.5–5.1 seconds **Continuous cut from Camera B to Camera C using a turn.** Start a small half-turn movement from a low angle. Switch to the front-right tracking camera mid-turn to connect the movement seamlessly. After completing the turn, the protagonist lifts one leg slightly and opens both arms diagonally. Hair, costume, and paper tape stop with a soft delay in sync with the final note of the song. ### 5.1–6.0 seconds **Camera E: Dynamic close-up.** The protagonist lowers the lifted leg while returning both hands to shoulder height. Lightly tilt the head to the opposite side and smile joyfully. Not a wink closing one eye, but a bright laugh while looking at the camera with both eyes. Surrounding paper effects are stored away as if being folded back into the page. End by returning to the same starting posture with hands at shoulder height. End just before the shoulders enter the next beat; looping will connect naturally to the shoulder movement at the beginning. ## Facial Expression Acting Do not keep expressions static even within the short duration. * Beginning: Slightly surprised eyes * First half: Joyful smile * Gaze return to camera: Slightly mischievous expression * Signature move: Confident smile * End: Friendly and bright smile Avoid excessive funny faces or expressions where facial features deform greatly. ## Virality-Focused Direction * Both characters and background move simultaneously from the start * Include expression changes within 0.3 seconds * Give distinct characteristics to foot movements as well as hand movements * Insert short cut-ins synchronized with the beat * Place the core of the choreography around the 2-3 second mark * Match the final pose with the starting preparation posture * Create a silhouette that looks cute even when paused * Use compositions where face, hand, and foot movements are distinguishable even on small screens * Do not increase information too much; focus attention on the protagonist ## Constraints * Do not feature any persons other than the protagonist * Maintain the character from the reference image in all cuts * Do not change face, hairstyle, hair color, eyes, physique, head-to-body ratio, or perceived age * Do not change or lose costumes, shoes, or accessories * Do not allow character changes during camera switches * Clearly differentiate the use of the 5 cameras * Keep actions and positions continuous even when switching cameras * Do not cut off the feet too much from the screen * Do not include unnatural high-speed spins or large jumps * Do not distort the number of limbs or joints * Do not use excessive camera shake, motion blur, or fisheye distortion * Do not use live-action style explosions, smoke, fire, or lightning * Do not use glitches, screen splits, or strobe lighting * Do not display text, subtitles, lyrics, logos, UIs, or watermarks * Do not reproduce existing songs or existing choreography ## Output Ideal Establish a strong opening hook, light footwork, a memorable signature move, detailed perspective changes with 5 cameras, synchronization with music, and a natural loop within the short 6-second duration. Create a cute, up-tempo, viral-specialized animated dance video that makes viewers want to replay it and imitate the 'Pata-Pata Step' to the music.

prompts.title: The Marble That Looked Back
prompts.prompt:
15-Second Animated Short – "The Marble That Looked Back"

Style: DreamWorks × Love, Death & Robots quality, ultra-detailed 3D animation, cinematic realism, volumetric lighting, magical atmosphere, macro cinematography, emotional orchestral score, 8K HDR, ray-traced reflections, shallow depth of field, smooth camera movement, no text, no watermark.

Scene 1 (0–2.5s) – The Discovery

At sunset, a curious 9-year-old child explores an ancient forest. Hidden beneath glowing moss lies a crystal marble no larger than a walnut, radiating soft cosmic light. The child gently picks it up, fascinated.

Scene 2 (2.5–5s) – A Living Universe

As the marble is held to the light, countless miniature galaxies, planets, comets, and colorful nebulae begin swirling inside. Tiny civilizations orbit glowing stars while microscopic spacecraft leave shimmering trails.

Scene 3 (5–7.5s) – The Impossible

The camera dives into the marble, revealing a breathtaking miniature universe. On a small planet, thousands of tiny people suddenly stop what they're doing at the exact same moment and slowly look upward in perfect synchronization.

Scene 4 (7.5–10s) – They Can See You

The child blinks in shock. Inside the marble, one tiny girl steps forward and raises her hand toward the sky. The entire civilization follows, silently pointing directly at the child beyond their universe.

Scene 5 (10–12.5s) – The Twist

The marble begins glowing intensely. The child's reflection appears on the surface—but inside the reflection, another enormous eye slowly opens behind the child, watching both worlds without moving.

Scene 6 (12.5–15s) – Endless Worlds

The camera rapidly pulls back. The child is revealed to exist inside another glowing marble resting in the palm of an unimaginably colossal cosmic being. The giant smiles softly as millions of identical universe-filled marbles orbit around it. Fade to black.

Ending feeling: The audience realizes that every universe may simply be a marble held by someone in an even larger reality, creating an infinite chain of worlds observing one another. This leaves viewers with awe, mystery, and a lingering question: Who is holding our universe?

A live-action thriller short film of an abandoned hospital escape room. The overall tone is cold, oppressive, and tense, creating fear through limited vision, narrow spaces, chasing sounds, and the character's restrained reactions, without using comedic twists.

Uses a subjective perspective of an old-fashioned DV tape camcorder. The image has soft details, low contrast, low-saturation cold gray-green tones, slight tape noise, and a coarse grain similar to 16mm film. Low-light areas retain identifiable levels, and large areas of pure black are prohibited.

Handheld shooting retains real step fluctuations, natural jitters, inertial offset during sudden turns, brief focus delays, and auto-exposure fluctuations. Jitters increase during the running phase, but the character, direction of action, and key movements must be clearly identifiable.

Small DV wide-angle lens, approximately 24-28mm equivalent perspective, medium depth of field, retaining corridor depth and spatial oppression. Prohibited: 3D rendering, game engine feel, refined commercial feel, stabilizer sliding, rail movement, orbiting, rolling, fisheye distortion, and groundless shaking.

Character skin maintains real pores and natural color, no beautification or skin smoothing. Real NPC skin is pale and tired but retains real actor texture; rubber masks, wax figures, or CG skin are prohibited.

【Duration / Aspect Ratio】
15 seconds, 9:16 vertical screen, 24fps, multiple hard cuts, not a one-take.

【Scene】
The scene is fixed in the same corridor of an abandoned hospital escape room.
Within the narrow and damp corridor, there is peeling wall skin, cracked old tiles, damaged medical records, rusty iron chains, shallow standing water, damaged cool white fluorescent lights, and intermittently flashing dark red emergency lights. In the distance, there is only a very weak green exit light.
At the end of the corridor is a heavy iron door that cannot be opened directly. An old-fashioned key mechanism is installed next to the iron door, and a closed secret door is hidden inside the wall next to the mechanism.
The flashlight in the female lead's hand is the main moving light source, only illuminating local areas; the beam must move realistically with the direction of the wrist. Prohibited: no-source fill light, neon lights, blue-purple stage lights, and the entire space being illuminated simultaneously.

【Female Lead】
The female lead's identity, face shape, features, hairstyle, clothing, accessories, shoes, and body proportions strictly refer to <image1> and remain consistent.
Refer only to the character and clothing in <image1>, ignoring the gray background, standing posture, layout, and facial occlusion areas of the reference image.
Whether in profile, looking back, under red light, in low light, or while running, she must be clearly identifiable as the same character.
The female lead always holds a small flashlight in her right hand and an old key in her left. Fear performance is realistically restrained, shown through accelerated breathing, frequent checking behind her, shaking hands, brief body pauses, and accelerated movements. Prohibited: continuous screaming, exaggerated staring, clumsy falling, performing towards the camera, or actively attacking NPCs.

【Core Props and Characters】
**Old Key and Mechanism:** The key fails to turn the first time due to a stuck lock cylinder, and triggers the wrong mechanism after extra force the second time. Once inserted, the key must remain in the mechanism.
**Real Horror NPC:** Wearing old and dirty hospital patient clothes, with messy long hair covering part of the face, dragging a heavy rusty metal tool in one hand. Initially approaches silently and steadily, without running, twitching, or making faces.
After seeing an unknown entity, the NPC sequentially: stops chasing, freezes, shows fearful eyes, loses hand strength, drops the metal tool, and immediately turns to flee. Fleeing must be a serious survival reaction.
**Unknown Entity:** Not part of the escape room game flow, only showing a pale slender humanoid hand, abnormal eyes in the dark, and non-human breathing. The hand must have real skin texture, joints, and nail structures; displaying the full body or face is prohibited.

【Editing Technique】
Uses a DV subjective perspective with multiple hard cuts. The photographer is a companion following the female lead into the room, always holding the camera, but the photographer themselves is not in frame and does not speak.
The camera moves mainly close behind the female lead's shoulder or side. Each hard cut follows a clear action or sound node: finding the tracker → distance shortens after lights out → key rotation failure → wrong mechanism starts → secret door opens → NPC truly terrified → NPC flees → unknown eyes appear. Prohibited: dissolves, white flashes, glitch transitions, slow motion, speed ramping, frame freezing, and hidden morph transitions.

【Shot 1】
The photographer holds the DV camera close behind the female lead's shoulder, following her through the abandoned hospital corridor.
The female lead uses the flashlight in her right hand to sweep across walls, medical records, chains, and water, holding the old key tightly in her left. She arrives at the iron door at the end of the corridor, quickly checking the door and the mechanism beside it.
Two irregular metal dragging sounds come from afar. The female lead stops immediately, breathing heavily, turning to look at the dark corridor behind her.
Hard cut.

【Shot 2】
The camera is behind and to the side of the female lead, retaining both the foreground of the female lead and the corridor depth.
The female lead shines the flashlight toward the end of the corridor; a real white-clothed NPC stands in the distance, body slightly tilted, the metal tool touching the ground.
The dark red emergency light suddenly goes out. Sounds of footsteps stepping through water and metal friction ring out in the darkness, rapidly approaching.
When the emergency light comes back on, the NPC has clearly shortened the distance through real walking. The female lead immediately turns and rushes toward the iron door mechanism.
Hard cut.

【Shot 3】
The camera is close to the front-side of the female lead, the frame retaining the female lead, the keyhole on the wall, and the corridor behind.
The female lead inserts the old key into the mechanism. The lock cylinder sticks on the first turn, the key colliding with the metal keyhole, fingers clearly shaking.
The footsteps and dragging sounds of the NPC continue to approach. The female lead applies more wrist force to turn the key a second time.
The iron door does not open. A heavy sound of a latch unlocking is heard first from inside the wall beside it, followed by slow gear operation sounds. The female lead freezes immediately, looking at the wall next to the mechanism.
Hard cut.

【Shot 4】
The frame simultaneously includes the female lead, the NPC behind her, the side wall secret door, and the mechanism position.
The wall slowly cracks open a narrow dark seam, dust and a few small stones fall naturally. The flashlight in the female lead's hand begins to flicker irregularly.
A pale slender humanoid hand stretches out from the darkness, then grabs the door frame, the finger bending and force being realistic.
The NPC has reached behind the female lead but suddenly stops chasing. Fearful eyes are visible under the long hair, hand loses strength, the heavy metal tool naturally hits the ground and briefly bounces.
Hard cut.

【Shot 5】
The NPC completely gives up chasing the female lead, turning to flee rapidly down the original corridor; the action is serious and real, without clumsy stumbling.
The female lead freezes in front of the iron door, only watching with her eyes as the NPC disappears into the darkness.
The photographer slowly turns the DV camera toward the secret door seam in the wall behind the female lead. The pale fingers tighten further, nails scraping the door frame.
In the depths of darkness, a pair of weak eyes appear at an abnormally high and unnaturally spaced position. The unknown entity lets out a very close, low-pitched inhalation toward the camera.
Immediately cut to black and end.

【Environment Sound and Sound Effects】
No background music or dialogue throughout.
Uses a built-in DV camera microphone texture, sound is slightly muffled, with real echoes of a closed hospital corridor.
Retains fluorescent light hum, slight ventilation duct vibration, female lead's rapid breathing, soles stepping through water, and distant metal dragging sounds.
When the NPC approaches, the water stepping and metal friction sounds gradually become clear. When the mechanism is triggered, sounds appear in sequence: key collision, lock cylinder sticking, latch unlocking, gear turning, and wall friction.
After the NPC stops, ambient sound briefly drops, highlighting the metal tool hitting the ground, the low inhalation inside the wall, and the sound of nails scraping the door frame. Finally, only one very close non-human inhalation is retained, followed by cutting to black.

Handheld and physically close to the  ground/bodies, with Dutch angles, fast push ins, pull backs, orbiting moves, short whip-pans and brief roll transitions. 0–2.5s: extreme low angle beside the staircase, tilted frame. Performer A looms near lens, Performer B deeper in the space. Sweep past legs and sneakers so a shoe briefly crosses the lens; reveal the ruined stairwell and bright exterior openings.

prompts.title: 16mm DV Fitness Vlog POV
prompts.prompt:
DV 16mm handheld film camera POV, filmed by CHASE, capturing herself naturally while occasionally placing the camera on flat benches, dumbbell racks, cable machines, or nearby gym equipment. Authentic handheld movement with subtle camera shake, slightly tilted framing, delayed autofocus, accidental zooms, imperfect composition, and occasional facial cropping. The camera itself never appears. Soft analog DV film look with gentle VHS grain, slight motion blur, blooming overhead light, slight exposure breathing, soft colors, realistic skin texture, natural sweat, and an immersive gym atmosphere.

Tone:

Playful, energetic, self-deprecating chest day vlog with genuine smiles, natural humor, real effort, authentic fatigue, and casual commentary. The video should feel completely unscripted, as if a real fitness creator is casually recording her workout.

Character:

CHASE is a beautiful Korean woman in her 20s with long black high ponytail, expressive eyes, naturally glowing sweaty skin, slim athletic build, wearing a fitted long-sleeve athletic crop top, high-waisted leggings, clean white training shoes, and a towel around her neck. No jewelry. Natural makeup. Healthy, realistic appearance.

Scene:

High-end modern evening gym with warm cinematic lighting, large windows, wood accent walls, bench press station, incline bench area, dumbbell rack, cable crossover machine, mirrored walls, rubber flooring, weight plates, water station, and a relaxed lounge corner. The environment should feel distinct from typical squat-rack-centric gym vlogs, creating a fresh visual atmosphere.

Shot Flow:

(1) Camera placed beside the bench press, CHASE adjusts the barbell, lies down, un-racks the weight, performs three clean controlled bench press reps, successfully re-racks, and sits up gasping and laughing.
“Alright... chest day officially started.”

(2) Handheld POV walking to the dumbbell rack. She selects a pair of dumbbells with a playful smile.
“These always look so light until I pick them up.”

(3) Camera placed beside the incline bench. She performs a full set of incline dumbbell presses with full range of motion, finishes the last rep, safely drops dumbbells to thighs, exhales deeply, and smiles proudly.
“Yeah... definitely felt that.”

(4) Cinematic macro sequence of loading weight plates, tightening collars, gripping cable handles, sweat dripping from hands, with only natural metal sounds and gym atmosphere.

Each exercise must show the full movement cycle from setup to completion, including preparation, execution, the final rep, and recovery before transitioning naturally to the next shot. prompts.title: Cinematic Coin Flip Mystery
prompts.prompt:
As first frame. A sharply dressed man in a dark blazer and black shirt stands in total darkness, a single gold coin balanced on his thumb, ready to flip.

0–2s: Extreme close-up on the coin resting on his thumb. Camera is low, almost table-level, shooting upward. A single warm overhead spotlight hits the coin, casting a circular golden reflection on the underside of his jaw. Everything else is consumed by void. He breathes once — visible in the cold air. His thumb twitches. In a deep, cold voice with long reverb decay: "Heads… or everything." A low metallic hum vibrates underneath, barely perceptible but felt in the chest.

2–5s: On the first bass hit, he flicks the coin upward. Time shifts to extreme slow motion. The coin rises, spinning on its horizontal axis — macro detail: engraved surface catching light, edge reflecting a thin golden line, air distortion around it. It reaches the apex of its arc and hangs there. It does not fall. It begins vibrating rapidly. Then it splits — one coin becomes two, two become four, four become sixteen. The multiplication accelerates exponentially, each new coin spinning at a slightly different speed. A sharp metallic ringing builds with each split, layered and harmonic. The camera slowly tilts upward following the expanding cloud.

5–9s: The soundtrack locks into an aggressive rhythmic drive. Thousands of spinning gold coins now fill the space above him. They begin moving — slowly at first, then violently — forming a massive golden tornado with him at its center. Camera cranes upward while orbiting 360 degrees. Coins slice through the air in tight spiraling layers, some passing dangerously close to the lens with metallic whoosh sounds. He stands motionless at the base, arms at his sides, chin tilted up, spotlight catching his face through gaps in the swirling gold. The tornado tightens, accelerates, roars — coins blur into a solid golden wall of spinning metal.

9–12s: At the peak of musical intensity, he raises one hand, palm flat. Instant silence. Every single coin freezes simultaneously mid-spin. Thousands of coins suspended in a perfect frozen tornado formation around him. Hold for one beat. Then he drops his hand. On the final massive bass hit, every coin plummets straight down at once — a deafening metallic avalanche crashing to the invisible floor. Coins bounce, scatter, ring, settle. Final shot: him standing in a sea of gold coins, the last one spinning on its edge in front of him. It wobbles, slows, falls flat. Hard cut to black.

Cinematic texture, film grain, anamorphic lens flare, shallow depth of field. Lighting: single warm overhead spotlight, golden reflections multiplying across coin surfaces. Audio: metallic hum, coin flick, harmonic ringing multiplication, silence-to-impact, aggressive rhythmic build, metallic tornado roar, instant silence, massive metallic avalanche crash, single coin spinning to rest.

thirties — chief trauma surgeon — stands at the

her neck, dried blood on her sleeve. Exhausted but 
completely still. She's already watching it.

A 25-story translucent biological creature moves 
through the city streets below — pale white body, 
bioluminescent blue veins pulsing like a heartbeat 
beneath its skin, featureless face. It dismantles 
buildings like it's studying them. It turns its 
face upward. Toward the hospital. Toward her.

She removes her surgical cap. Peels off her latex 
gloves one by one. Drops them — wind takes them 
off the edge. Sets her stethoscope on the ledge. 
Closes her eyes. The entire hospital electrical 
system surges below her.

Cold white-blue light bleeds upward through the 
rooftop and flows into her — scrubs dissolve, 
replaced by sleek bio-mechanical surgical steel 
armor with bioluminescent blue vein patterns 
across every plate, mirroring the creature exactly. 
Precision instrument tips extend from her gauntlet 
fingers. Faceplate assembles last — visor glowing 
cold clinical blue. She steps off the rooftop 
without hesitation and descends controlled, 
blue trail rising above her.

She meets the creature at street level. Lands in 
a crouch. Looks up at its featureless face. Their 
bioluminescent veins pulse in the same rhythm 
once. She stands. Drives both gauntleted hands 
into its chest — not to destroy, to operate. 
She finds the core. Pulls it free. Compresses 
it between both palms. Cold white implosion. 
The creature goes dark vein by vein from the 
chest outward. Ceases. Dissolves upward 
into evening air like breath in winter.

She stands alone in the empty street. Armor 
fades. Scrubs back. Stethoscope around her 
neck again. She looks at her hands — clean. 
Walks back through the hospital doors. 
Pauses. Looks back once at the empty street. 
Then: "Get me back to OR 3. I have a patient."

One continuous take. No cuts. No score. 
Only wind, hospital hum, and city silence 
returning. She didn't fight it. She diagnosed it.

One active condition that belongs to the red phase. 4. The source of that condition. 5. The path or relation through which it travels. 6. The receiving subject, object, region, or surface. 7. The visible consequence. 8. Two or three transition sites where the records meet. Choose the active condition from the user's request. It may be physical, social, temporal, or perceptual. Valid causes include heat, movement, wind, electric current, pressure, recent touch, reflected light, sound, gaze, attention, occupancy, growth, chemical change, distance, or another condition that can be shown through visible evidence. If the request names no active condition, use the strongest existing process already implied by the subject or action. Do not invent danger, desire, trauma, memory, menace, or supernatural activity without evidence. Red is a measurement channel, not a mood label. Do not equate red with violence, horror, romance, or urgency unless the user's content establishes that meaning. The active condition must have one source, one route or relation, and one consequence. Do not scatter red accents without a causal structure. CONTENT CONTROL Preserve the user's explicit subject, count, identity requirements, action or state, setting, era, clothing, objects,
prompts.description: A detailed system prompt for creating structured image prompts based on the Redphase Survey visual system, utilizing a dual-record logic of scene occupancy and active conditions.

参照画像の人物の無修正ドキュメンタリー風写真。85mm単焦点レンズ搭載のフルサイズデジタルカメラで撮影。年齢、性別、祖先、顔、髪、肌の色と質感、体型、身長の印象、プロポーションなど、あらゆる身体的特徴を参照画像からのみ忠実に推測・保持し、決して美化、年齢操作、整形、特徴の捏造を行わないこと。これは胴体全体に適用される。胸部やバストのサイズ、形状、位置、肩幅、肋骨、ウエスト、ヒップ、四肢の太さはすべて、参照画像に表示されている通りとする。胸部を拡大、縮小、リフトアップ、丸くするなどの変更を加えず、体のどの部分も細くしたり、長くしたり、理想化したりしない。参照画像が明白に成人を描いている場合にのみ、柔らかいネックラインとフィットしたショーツを使用し、そうでない場合は、ネックラインが鎖骨の位置にあるキャミソールと、同じ色と雰囲気のストレートカットの太もも丈のショーツを使用する。いずれの場合も、ショーツは完全に不透明で、下着が見えないようにする。シーン：7月下旬の古い日本家屋の木製縁側を庭から見た様子。風化した暗い色の木柱と紙の障子が背景を埋め、開いた戸口の向こうに薄暗い部屋が見える。軒先から被写体の横、頭の高さあたりに、短冊の付いた小さなガラスの風鈴が吊るされている。右下の床には、カットされたスイカが乗った白いエナメル盆の縁が入っている。左端には夏の緑が迫っている。床板は不均一に摩耗し、本物の木目や擦り傷がある。ポーズ：被写体は一段高い縁側の端に座り、カメラに対してきれいな横向きで、体の正面は庭の方を向いている。片方の膝を立てて素足を床に乗せ、もう片方の足は縁側から下に伸ばしている。被写体は片手にスイカの一片を持ち、顔の横から口元に運び、その肘は立てた膝の近くに置かれている。もう片方の腕は後ろに伸ばし、手のひらを腰の後ろの床に平らに押し付けているため、胴体は直立して開いた状態になり、胸の前を遮るものはない。視線はカメラから離れ、庭の向こうを向いている。表情は気だるげでポーズを取っておらず、撮影のために静止しているのではなく、一口食べている途中の瞬間を捉えたものである。服装：サンドアイボリーのコットンジャージー素材の、何度も洗濯された使い古された日常的なキャミソール。ニットは柔らかく少しへたっており、縁取りされたネックラインは元の張りを失い、作られた時よりも少し低く緩んでいる。細いストラップは着用により伸びており、ピンと張るのではなく緩んでいるが、両方とも肩に正しく留まっている。色は不均一に色あせ、裾はわずかにカールし、生地には夏の間ずっと家で着ていた衣服特有の定着したシワがある。完全に不透明で、構造やパッドはなく、成形やサポートも組み込まれていないため、単に参照の身体に従っている。スレートグレーのコットンリネンショーツも同様に使い古されて柔らかく、体にフィットしたカットで裾は太ももの高い位置にあり、リラックスしたドローストリングは結ばれずに残され、座ったことによる軽いシワがある。ヒーロービジュアル：木柱、障子のレール、風鈴の吊り紐など、フレーム内のすべての垂直線は完全に静止しており、風鈴の下の短冊だけが写真の中で揺れている唯一の要素で、垂直からわずかに外れてぶら下がっている。カメラとフレーミング：庭から座った時の肩の高さあたりで撮影されたミディアムショット。傾きのない水平な位置で、被写体の横顔に対して正対している。フレームは頭のすぐ上から太ももの中間までで、顔全体、両肩、胴体全体、ウエスト、座った腰、太ももの上半分がすべてはっきりと読み取れ、フレームを満たしている。膝下でクロップし、下脚と足は写さない。カメラを被写体の後ろに配置しないこと。胴体の前面と横顔の両方が読み取れなければならない。股の間をフレームに収めないこと。ライティング：自然光のみ。曇天の明るい真夏の正午。開けた庭からの柔らかく均一な日光、被写体の後ろで深い自然な陰影になる縁側の内部、芝生からの肌への涼しげな緑の反射光、木材からのわずかな暖かい反射光。スタジオライト、リムライト、人工的なフィルライトは使用しない。写真のリアリズム：全体を通して本物の光学挙動。f/2.8前後の適度な被写界深度で、背景の障子と緑は緩やかに柔らかく、顔に焦点を合わせる。軽微なレンズ周辺減光、最も明るいハイライト部分のかすかな色収差、影になった室内の自然なセンサーノイズ、ガラスの風鈴とエナメル盆のわずかにクリップされた鏡面ハイライト。肌のスムージング、エアブラシ、いかなる種類のレタッチも行わない。生地は本物の重力の下で本物のシワを持ってドレープする。コットンジャージーは、柔らかい折り目があり、パリッとした感じがなく、硬い構造を持たない、本物の着古されたニットのように振る舞う。フォーマット：3:4 縦長。レンダリングやイラストではなく、キャンディッド・フォト（スナップ写真）。CGIのような外観、プラスチックのような肌、HDRの輝き、デジタルシャープニングのハロー、ビューティーフィルターはなし。

They look at each other. Inside the SUV, a third “commander” barks through the radio: “Abort. Wrong house. Again.” The agents slowly lower their sunglasses. The dad shrugs, walks back inside. Cut to kitchen. He sits at the table with his cereal. Turns on the TV. BREAKING NEWS: “International spy ring apprehended after staking out random suburban dad for third straight day.” He crunches loudly. Milk drips down his chin. He sighs. “Finally.”

The eyes should be slightly misaligned, one bigger than the other, with crooked eyelashes and uneven pupils. The nose should be awkwardly shaped, the mouth lopsided and poorly filled. Emphasize the low-quality pixel-by-pixel feel with visible compression artifacts, dithering, and 1990s Windows 95 aesthetic. The overall drawing should be vaguely similar to the reference but also not really — kind of matching but off in a confusing, awkward, and hilarious way. Proportions should be ridiculous, symmetry completely broken, colors oversaturated or completely wrong in places. Exaggerate every flaw while still keeping the core identity of the exact face from the reference image recognizable but hilariously distorted. Photorealistic accuracy is forbidden. prompts.prompt: Transform the entire image into an authentic screenshot captured directly from a {argument name="console era" default="late-1990s PlayStation 1 (PS1)"} video game running on original hardware. Remove all anti-aliasing entirely — every edge must be sharply jagged and aliased with prominent stair-stepping. Simulate the PS1’s 16-bit color depth and 5-5-5 RGB limitations by introducing visible checkerboard or ordered dithering patterns in all color gradients, skies, shadows, and semi-transparent areas to prevent banding. Include typical PS1 graphical quirks: subtle vertex snapping/jitter/wobbling on moving or angled geometry, minor polygon pop-in or Z-fighting where appropriate, and a limited draw distance that may softly fade into a low-detail fog. The overall resolution should feel like a raw {argument name="resolution" default="320×240"} or 640×480 PS1 framebuffer output, giving the whole image a slightly soft yet crunchy retro pixel look when viewed at modern sizes. Preserve the original scene composition and camera angle exactly, but convert everything into this pure PS1 3D style as if the photo itself were modeled and rendered inside an actual PS1 game. No text overlays, no HUD elements, no subtitles, no menu graphics, no scanlines, no CRT curvature, and no modern post-processing of any kind — just a clean, direct screenshot from the console’s video output.

They travel across the concrete floor in opposite directions and meet nearby in the same scene. Elemental Interaction Where the rivers meet, the collision creates violent physical contrast: steam, glowing cracks, frost bloom, blackened wet concrete, cooling rock, and frozen shards. The meeting point must feel emotionally symbolic, like two inner states colliding. Creature Creation Story (CRITICAL) The lava and ice pouring from the palms are actively creating creatures on the floor. These creatures must feel born from the flowing material itself, not placed into the scene afterward. Some creatures are still forming out of the streams. Some are fully shaped and wandering around the seated character. Lava creatures: glowing, semi-molten, ember-veined, heat-distorted silhouettes. Ice creatures: translucent, frosted, crystalline, sharp-edged, cold-vapor silhouettes. They should vary in size and animals language, all kind of animals and insects. A few lava and ice creatures are already surrounding the character in quiet loyalty or silent observation. Character Pose & Emotion The character is seated, still, introspective, emotionally exhausted. Head slightly lowered. Shoulders carrying invisible weight. Palms open and angled downward so the lava and ice pour naturally from them. The pose must feel like grief, restraint, and power at the same time. Not a triumphant spellcasting pose. Not action-hero energy. Quiet sorrow. Controlled destruction. Environment A dark basement interior with: unfinished concrete floor, aged walls, pipes and exposed structure, subtle moisture stains, minimal objects, deep negative space. The basement should feel real, sparse, and slightly abandoned. The elemental rivers become the main environmental storytelling device. Camera & Perspective Use a low cinematic perspective, slightly below the seated character's eye line. Lens: 24mm or 28mm. The camera is close enough to feel intimate but wide enough to show the rivers spreading across the floor and the creatures surrounding the character. Composition should be slightly off-center, not symmetrical. Use foreground depth with one or two blurred creatures or fragments near the lens. The seated character remains the emotional anchor. Depth of Field Primary focal plane locked on the character's face, upper torso, and both pouring palms. Nearest creatures and the river collision point can remain slightly readable. Foreground and far background fall progressively out of focus. No full-frame sharpness. Lighting Main light: a weak cool basement lamp overhead, dim and emotionally cold. Ambient: dark blue low-light atmosphere throughout the basement. Secondary light comes naturally from the lava itself, casting warm orange-red underlight onto parts of the character and nearby creatures. Ice contributes faint cold reflections and subtle blue-white edge highlights. Lighting must stay directional and cinematic, with deep shadow mass and controlled contrast. No flat lighting. Color Grade Dominant palette: dark blue, cold grey, black shadow. Accents: molten orange-red from lava, pale cyan-blue from ice. The warm and cool elements must remain clearly separated and emotionally readable. Controlled saturation, cinematic highlight roll-off, no color flooding. Atmosphere Thin basement haze. Steam rising where lava and ice meet. Cold vapor around the ice creatures. Subtle airborne dust catching the weak overhead lamp. The air should feel heavy and lonely. Mood Melancholic. Mythic but grounded. The scene should feel like inner conflict externalized into the physical world. The character is not commanding the creatures. They are simply emerging from what the character cannot hold inside. Negative Constraints No heroic battle pose. No cheerful fantasy lighting. No flat basement rendering. No symmetrical centered composition. No generic fireballs or magic aura. No full-body sharpness. No random clutter. No cute cartoon expression unless it already belongs to the character identity. prompts.title: Advanced Two-Step Prompting Strategy for Nano Banana Pro Thumbnails
prompts.prompt: Actually, there's a trickier way to use this. First, have it systematically summarize the information → Then, based on that, have it create the output/deepen the discussion Just doing this makes the quality of the output completely different. This is because if you first create a blueprint in the AI's mind—including "terminology," "judgment criteria," "prohibited items," "patterns," and "priorities"— The next instructions will be output according to that blueprint, making it less likely to deviate. For example, if you want Nano Banana Pro to create a thumbnail: ① First, ask GPT-5.2: "Thoroughly research and systematize the best practices for creating prompts for YouTube thumbnails using Nano Banana Pro. Include common mistakes as well." ② After that, ask: "Based on the current system, create a prompt for making a YouTube thumbnail on the theme of {argument name="theme" default="XX"} using Nano Banana Pro. The video content is like this, and I want to include {argument name="wording" default="this kind of wording"}." Then, input the completed prompt into Nano Banana Pro. It becomes much easier to get the desired output. If you just ask it to "create" every time, the AI outputs based on the moment, leading to inconsistent results. But if you create a map (system) first, it's powerful. Moreover, this method works for side business strategies, sales copy, and video scripts. The versatility is insane. I highly recommend having the AI organize how to create good output before having it perform the task, and then having it think based on that organization. By the way, the thumbnail created this time is the third image. Since the first attempt was mediocre, I had it systematize how to create attractive YouTube thumbnails before generating the prompt.
prompts.description: This tweet outlines an advanced, two-step prompting strategy to significantly improve the quality of AI output, specifically for generating YouTube thumbnails using Nano Banana Pro. The strategy involves first asking a powerful LLM (like GPT-5.2) to systematically summarize the best practices, terminology, and constraints for creating Nano Banana Pro prompts (creating a 'map'). Likeness Preservation (CRITICAL): The identity of the character must remain exactly identical to the reference in both: • the miniature physical character • the character shown in the design sketches. The sketch pages must show the same character, including: • dynamic poses small sketches • head studies and shape explorations • proportion notes • accessory sketches • construction diagrams • small handwritten annotations. Do not humanize the character. Do not reinterpret anatomy. Subject & Action: The miniature character sprints explosively across the design pages, tearing through the sketch sheet as it runs. The character is captured at the peak stride moment of a full-speed sprint. Running pose details: • the body leans sharply forward as if accelerating • one leg is fully extended forward while the other drives powerfully backward • arms pump in opposite running motion • the torso twists slightly creating a dynamic curved spine line • the pose feels like a high-speed comic-book sprint. The character’s momentum rips through the paper, creating a jagged torn path behind it. A trail of torn paper curls and fragments with vfx follows behind the running character as if it burst out of its own design. Oversized design sheets surround the character, each page showing different stages of development of the same character. One small grey 3d print of the character is in the background as an exact copy of the uploaded image. Camera & Perspective: Captured from a medium camera distance above the desk, allowing a wider portion of the surrounding design pages to be visible. Shot with an 85mm macro lens, creating natural compression while keeping the environment readable. The camera sits slightly elevated and angled downward toward the running character. The character remains the focal point but occupies roughly one third of the frame, revealing more of the design sheets and workspace around it. The character remains slightly off-center within the spotlight. Depth of Field: Extremely shallow depth of field. The sprinting miniature character and the immediate section of the torn sketch page are razor sharp. Surrounding pages and distant elements fall into soft blur. Lighting (VERY DRAMATIC): A single narrow spotlight / flashlight beam hits the character. The beam comes from a side-front direction, creating a bright circular pool of light on the design page. Lighting characteristics: • extremely hard light • very high contrast • no ambient fill light • the surrounding elements fades into near-total darkness • sharp dramatic shadows stretch across the paper • edges of the light beam fall rapidly into black. The environment outside the spotlight should feel almost completely swallowed by darkness, as if the character has been suddenly caught under a stage light. Dust particles float through the beam. Environment & Surface Detail: Macro-level detail of the design pages: • ink texture • pencil strokes • paper fibers • subtle reflections on graphite lines. The torn paper edge reveals fibrous paper layers and curled fragments along the ripped path. Subtle Heat Burn Detail: Along parts of the torn path, the paper shows light scorching caused by extreme speed friction: • edges of some tears are slightly darkened and singed • faint burnt browning transitions into the white paper fibers • tiny ember-like glowing specks appear briefly along the freshest tear points • very subtle wisps of heat distortion or smoke rise from a few edges. The burn effect must remain minimal, believable, and physically grounded, enhancing realism without turning into flames or overpowering the scene. Color Grade: Desaturated sketch pages and environment. The character receives cool cinematic highlights from the spotlight. Moody macro photography atmosphere. Rendering Style: Photorealistic macro toy photography, emphasizing scale illusion between the tiny character and the giant design pages. Speed Energy VFX: A stylized high-speed energy trail follows behind the running character, emphasizing the explosive sprint. The trail consists of thin luminous motion streaks and glowing particles streaming backward from the character’s movement direction. Characteristics: • energy streaks originate from behind the character’s shoulders, arms, and legs • streaks extend diagonally backward, following the direction of motion • the lines are semi-transparent glowing blue light trails • small sparkling particles scatter along the trail • the effect should feel like comic-book speed energy, not smoke or fire • the VFX enhances motion but does not cover or obscure the character. The light streaks interact subtly with the environment: • faint glow reflecting on the torn paper edges • slight blue rim light on the character’s silhouette • a few glowing particles floating through the spotlight beam. A mezzanine or upper level is built above with structural elements attached directly to the box walls and connected via STAIR_TYPE. Exterior ornamentation must continue logically into interior architecture. Doors and windows must be precisely cut into the box sides following decorative carving patterns. prompts.title: Dominance portrait generation prompt (Gemini - Thinking mode)
prompts.prompt: Create a dominance portrait of the uploaded reference character seated on a divine throne that feels engineered from their own world and design language. The camera observes the ruler from a partially obstructed viewpoint, as if the viewer is looking through the monumental structure of the throne itself. Likeness Integrity (HIGHEST PRIORITY) Maintain exact: • Head-to-body proportions • Eye shape, spacing, stylization • Surface materials • Silhouette and structural design Do not humanize. Do not reinterpret anatomy. Do not add unintended accessories. Perspective exaggeration must come only from camera placement, not structural redesign. Identity always wins. Throne Adaptation System (UNIVERSAL LOGIC) The throne must feel like a structural extension of the character’s design universe and must feel divine. Rules: Extract design language from the character: Dominant material logic Geometric language Color World energy Translate, never copy. Echo shapes subtly in silhouette Reflect material family, not exact textures Use tonal harmony, not color duplication Patterns may appear in architecture, structure, or ornamentation but must remain subordinate to the character’s identity. Camera & Perspective • Camera positioned slightly below the throne platform but offset laterally • 16–20mm wide cinematic lens • The throne structure partially obstructs the frame • Large architectural element of the throne occupies the foreground edge of the frame • Character visible through the throne’s structural opening or between its elements • Horizon slightly tilted 5–8 degrees • The viewer feels as if witnessing the ruler from behind the architecture of power Foreground elements must feel massive and close to the lens, framing the character like a monumental gateway. Composition • The character sits centered within the throne structure but partially framed by its geometry • Throne architecture creates a natural visual tunnel toward the character • Foreground throne elements remain slightly out of focus • Character remains the focal authority within the frame Lighting • Singular vertical divine beam descending from above the throne • Volumetric haze revealing light shafts • Strong rim light outlining the character silhouette • Controlled specular spikes along throne edges • Foreground throne elements remain darker, creating contrast against the illuminated ruler Depth & Focus • Eyes in absolute clarity • Character face and upper torso remain sharp • Foreground throne structure slightly blurred from proximity to lens • Background dissolves into atmospheric layers The image must feel layered in depth: foreground architecture → seated ruler → atmospheric background. Background • Vast negative space above the throne • Atmospheric tension • Light beam

The prompt emphasizes strict likeness integrity, engineering the throne from the character's design language, and specific cinematic camera/lighting techniques (wide lens, partial obstruction, vertical divine beam).

prompts.title: Asimov Visionary Split-Scene Concept Art Prompt
prompts.prompt: Do this for Asimov: 1. The Analysis: Analyze Input: Identify the Visionary's Era (e.g., 1950s) and their Core Predictions (e.g., Robotics, AI). Left Side (The Origin): Construct the room based on the actual historical workspace of the person (e.g., Typewriters, cigarette smoke, blueprints, tungsten light). Right Side (The Legacy): Construct the room based on the modern realization of their ideas (e.g., Clean server room, holograms, advanced prosthetics, cool LED light). 2. Composition (The Rift): The Divide: A diagonal beam of light splits the room. The Subject: The Visionary stands dead center. Left Half of Body: Dressed in period clothing, holding a pen/paper. Right Half of Body: Fading into digital pixels or observing a floating hologram of their invention. The Wall: Left Wall: Covered in pinned sketches and paper notes. Right Wall: A floor-to-ceiling window looking out onto a futuristic city (The world they predicted). 3. Visual Cohesion: The perspective lines of the room must match perfectly across the split. A wooden desk on the left might morph into a sleek glass interface on the right. Lighting: Warm/Dusty (Left) vs. Cold/Sterile (Right). Output: ONE image, 16:9 Aspect Ratio, Cinematic Concept Art, Photorealistic.
prompts.description: A complex, multi-step prompt designed to generate a cinematic concept art image (16:9) that visually splits a scene diagonally, contrasting a visionary's historical workspace (e.g., Asimov) with the modern realization of their ideas, using contrasting lighting and elements.

prompts.title: Samurai Sniper Dynamic Battle Scene Prompt
prompts.prompt: Masterpiece quality, theatrical anime-scale dynamic battle scene. A samurai character is the main subject (preserving a traditional samurai feel, optionally blended with subtle modern gear elements). Prone firing pose (low-profile/propped close to the roof surface), body flattened to the tiles, elbows braced for stability. Cheek pressed to the stock while peering through the scope, one eye narrowed, an intense focused stare and clenched teeth conveying tension and determination. Composition and angle: the camera is placed almost on the roof tiles—an extreme ground-level ultra low-angle. Wide-angle lens with exaggerated perspective and strong depth. A diagonal composition: the sniper rifle runs from the extreme lower foreground into the midground, leading the viewer’s eye directly to the samurai’s gaze. The muzzle and muzzle flash dominate the extreme foreground, appearing oversized and close enough to “break the screen,” while the face (especially the eyes) stays crisp and sharp. Action: captured at the exact instant of firing. A large, stylized muzzle flash erupts in the foreground; sparks, glowing embers, and thin smoke burst outward. Ejected brass and scattered casings on the tiles reinforce the sense of ongoing fire. A faint luminous streak suggests the bullet’s path slicing through the night air. Subtle recoil pushes the rifle and shoulder back; dynamic motion blur on the weapon and sleeves, while the eyes and brow remain tack-sharp. The scope glass reflects a cold blue-green sheen; metal surfaces show finely detailed reflections and crisp edge highlights. Setting: the rooftop of a white Japanese castle keep (white plaster walls), under a clear night sky. Clean moonlight creates strong rim lighting along roof ridges and the samurai’s silhouette. Traditional roof features—curved ceramic tiles, ridge lines, gables, and shachihoko ornaments—read clearly in silhouette and detail. The firing shock and weight shift chip and crack tiles; fragments and dust jump up and arc toward the camera. High-contrast cinematic lighting with a dramatic warm–cool split: warm muzzle flash versus cool moonlight. Filmic particles (dust, embers) in the air. Vertical cinematic poster composition, 9:16 aspect ratio, no text.
prompts.description: A highly detailed, cinematic prompt for generating a dynamic anime-scale battle scene featuring a samurai sniper in a prone firing pose on a Japanese castle rooftop at night, emphasizing extreme low-angle composition, muzzle flash, and high-contrast lighting.

prompts.title: High Speed Action Editorial
prompts.prompt: A high fashion studio action shot designed with a cinematic, hyper dynamic editorial approach that captures movement, tension, and frozen energy in a single frame. The scene is set against a dark, solid seamless background that absorbs light and enhances contrast, creating a dramatic void-like environment that isolates the subject and emphasizes form, motion, and lighting precision. The lighting setup is a hard strobe configuration, engineered to produce crisp, sculptural highlights and deep, defined shadows with razor sharp edges. Every contour of the model, fabric, and airborne particles is sharply defined through high intensity flash timing combined with a high shutter speed freeze, ensuring that even the fastest motion appears suspended in time with absolute clarity. The camera is positioned at a {argument name="focal length" default="SUPER ultra wide 12mm"} focal length, exaggerating perspective and adding immersive distortion that enhances speed and impact. A side tracking angle is used, following the model’s motion laterally to intensify the feeling of acceleration and directional force. This perspective makes the scene feel as if the viewer is moving alongside the subject in real time. The model is captured mid action, {argument name="action" default="lunging aggressively into a full sprint"} with powerful athletic energy. The body posture conveys urgency and momentum, with forward drive clearly visible in the stride, shoulders angled into motion, and core engaged. Hair whips violently backward due to rapid acceleration, forming fluid arcs that contrast with the sharp frozen lighting style. In the foreground and motion path, {argument name="liquid effect" default="an iced coffee is captured mid spill, exploding into a long, elegant arc of liquid suspended in mid air"}. Droplets are individually visible, frozen at different distances from the cup, creating a sense of chaotic precision. Crushed ice fragments scatter outward, each piece sharply defined and glinting under the strobe light, enhancing texture and realism. The composition emphasizes controlled chaos, balancing fashion editorial aesthetics with raw kinetic energy. The wardrobe is sleek and high fashion, designed to complement motion without cluttering the visual narrative. Fabric reacts naturally to speed, creating flowing trails and subtle tension folds. Overall, the image blends luxury fashion photography with extreme motion capture techniques, resulting in a visually striking moment that feels both cinematic and impossible, as if time itself has been stopped at the peak of action.
prompts.description: A hyper-dynamic fashion editorial prompt featuring a model in a sprint with an exploding iced coffee spill, shot at an ultra-wide angle.

prompts.title: 2x2 Grid Product Invention Visualization (Patent/Marketing)
prompts.prompt: Input Variable: {argument name="input objects" default="[INSERT 1 or 2 OBJECTS]"} Instruction: Act as a Visionary Industrial Designer and Patent Clerk. Create a 2x2 Grid visualizing the invention of a new product based on the Input. Innovation Logic : Analyze Functions: Identify the primary utility of Input A and Input B. The Fusion: Combine them into a single, cohesive device that solves a specific (niche) problem. If 2 Inputs: Hybridize them (e.g., Mug + Grater = A self-cooling mug with a garnish shaver). If 1 Input: Evolve it (e.g., Toothbrush = A self-sanitizing, toothpaste-injecting smart wand). The Branding: Generate a catchy, corporate product name (e.g., "The Breeze-Grate™", "Solar-Brella Pro"). The Visual Structure (The 2x2 Grid): CRITICAL: The image must be split into 4 distinct quadrants with different visual styles. Panel 1 (Top Left): The Exploded Patent View Style: Black & White Technical Line Art. Thin distinct lines, no shading. Content: An isometric "Exploded View" of the device, showing the internal motor, battery, or mechanism separated from the shell. Detail: Add Numbered Leader Lines (10, 12, 14) pointing to specific parts. Panel 2 (Top Right): The Functional Diagram Style: Black & White Schematic with bold arrows. Content: A cross-section or "In-Use" drawing showing how how the device works. Use Action Arrows to show airflow, rotation, or liquid movement. Detail: Show the "Result" (e.g., cheese falling, water spraying). Panel 3 (Bottom Left): The Product Render Style: High-End Studio Photography. Color, Glossy, "Apple/Braun" Design Aesthetic. Content: The final physical product sitting on a white reflective surface. It should look sleek, using materials like White Ceramic, Brushed Aluminum, or Matte Plastic. Context: Include a small prop to show scale (e.g., a block of cheese, a coffee bean, a hand). Panel 4 (Bottom Right): The Marketing Pitch Style: Editorial Magazine Layout. White background, black text. Typography: Headline: Large, Bold Serif Text displaying the [Invention Name]. Body: A block of clean "Lorem Ipsum" or readable text describing the "Revolutionary Features." Bullets: A small list of specs (e.g., "Dishwasher Safe," "USB-C"). Visual Syntax: Cohesion: The product design in Panel 3 must perfectly match the line art in Panel 1. Design Language: Minimalist, Ergonomic, Consumer Electronics aesthetic. Even if the idea is silly, the design must look expensive. Output: 2x2 Grid, Mixed Media (Line Art vs. Photorealism), 8k Resolution, "Kickstarter Campaign" Aesthetic.
prompts.description: A complex, multi-panel prompt designed to visualize the invention and marketing of a new product by combining two concepts (or evolving one). It mandates a 2x2 grid structure, with each quadrant requiring a distinct visual style: technical line art (Exploded Patent View), schematic diagram (Functional Diagram), photorealistic render (Product Render), and editorial layout (Marketing Pitch). The prompt acts as an industrial designer, focusing on cohesion between the panels and a minimalist, consumer electronics aesthetic.

prompts.prompt: A cinematic speed-motion shot of the uploaded reference character captured mid-slide on a rain-slicked, neon-drenched cyberpunk street. The focus is equally on the reflection and the character, forming a dual-layer composition. Likeness Preservation (CRITICAL): Maintain exact proportions, eye shape, spacing, stylization, silhouette, and material identity from the reference. Do not humanize. Do not reinterpret anatomy. Do not modify facial structure. Identity must remain perfectly intact and instantly recognizable. 2D to 3D Translation (ONLY if input is 2D artwork): If the uploaded reference is 2D (illustration, anime, flat graphic, cel-shaded), convert it into a fully realized 3D cinematic form while preserving exact identity fidelity. Maintain exact head shape, eye design, spacing, and proportions. Preserve original stylization, do NOT add realism that alters design language. Translate linework into subtle surface geometry or shading transitions. Keep original colors, expressed through physically believable materials. Convert flat shading into controlled cinematic light falloff. The result must feel physically real, not redesigned. Camera & Perspective: Ultra-low angle, camera positioned just centimeters above the wet pavement. Lens: 18–20mm ultra-wide. Slight Dutch tilt (5–10 degrees) to destabilize the frame. Front three-quarter perspective. One limb or body part must be closer to the lens, creating perspective pressure. Composition (Reflection Dominance): The character slices diagonally across the upper half of the frame. The lower half is dominated by a sharp but slightly distorted reflection. Vertical neon signs in the background must mirror into the wet ground, forming strong graphic lines. The composition must feel off-balance and tension-driven, not centered or stable. Pose Enforcement (CRITICAL — OVERRIDE ALL DEFAULT STANCES): The character must NOT be upright, balanced, or casually sliding. The pose must represent loss of balance under high speed. prompts.title: World-in-a-Box Cutaway Diorama Prompt
prompts.prompt: role: You are a cutaway diorama builder and practical-effects set designer.
